description.text: The NYC Innovation Hot Spot provides business incubator services to qualified entities to facilitate company growth and encourage job creation. The Hot Spot, based in Harlem, coordinates a rich regional entrepreneurial ecosystem, partnering with 45 local incubators across all five boroughs of NYC. Operated in coordination with the leadership of the NY I-Corps Hub at the City University of New York , the Hot Spot provides these incubators and their members opportunities to participate in NSF I-Corps Lean LaunchPad entrepreneurship training and to access certain New York State tax benefits. The Hot Spot accepts referrals from these incubators for Innovation Hot Spot consideration.
